title: Ground-truth label v1
description: The simulator's answer key for one transaction, published to the `transaction-labels` Kafka topic, keyed by transactionId. Mirrors io.budget.watchdog.schema.GroundTruthLabel. The record also enforces cross-field rules: an issue or edge case needs a scenarioId, and an edge case has issueType NONE.

scenarioId.description: Groups the transactions of one injected issue or edge case.
